name: DualSouls (Hollow Knight)

assets.needs: Your own Hollow Knight PC folder (Steam layout hollow_knight_Data or GOG Hollow Knight_Data, v1.5.12620, all 1761 files unmodified) plus hk-android-gog.xdelta from the same release. The app's Import Game screen patches them into its own OBB (~1 GB).
assets.location: Source: a Hollow Knight PC folder plus hk-android-gog.xdelta (924 MB), picked in Import Game. Built data: /sdcard/Android/data/igawa6.dualsouls/files/ (main.1.igawa6.dualsouls.obb + hk_data_stamp.txt).
assets.notes: Needs Files permission on Android 13+ or Unity will not mount the data. The xdelta must come from the same release as the APK (1.0.3).

settings.in_app_menu: Hub screen at launch (Import Game, Save Files, Skins, Mod menu toggle). In game: Hollow Knight's own Options > Game/Controller screens carry two added rows (Dual Screen, Touch Controls); the bottom-screen gear opens the mod pane when Mod menu is ticked.
settings.summary: Dual Screen on/off, Touch Controls auto/on/off, controller glyph type and Nintendo face-button swap, bottom-screen companion, FPS/battery readout. Framerate is forced to 120 (vSync off) by the port; Hollow Knight's own video options live in Unity PlayerPrefs.

controls: Built-in Thor pad detected (vid 8224 / name 'odin' or 'ayn') and gets Nintendo glyphs with A/B and X/Y swapped by default (swapFaceButtons=1). External Xbox/PS4/PS5/Switch pads get their own glyphs. Touch controls appear when no pad is present. Rumble through the Thor motor.
display: Built for the Thor: game on top; bottom screen (Presentation display) shows the HUD mirror plus Map/Inventory/Charms companion panes (touch), dialogue/tutorial overlays, FPS and battery. Set Dual Screen off to put the HUD back on top.
saves: /sdcard/Android/data/igawa6.dualsouls/files/ (Hollow Knight's four save slots, per README; file names not checked). Hub > Save Files exports/imports slots. PC saves are not directly compatible. Uninstalling deletes saves and built data; Clear storage is a factory reset.
notes: A same-version Unity (il2cpp) rebuild of the game made with AssetRipper; some shaders are hand-reconstructed, cutscenes re-encoded to VP8. Never uninstall to update: install over the top. If release notes say 'game data rebuild required', re-run Build game data with the new patch. Same author (igawa6) maintains a dual-screen Dusklight fork and other Thor ports.
verified: On device: dumpsys, data dirs. APK: com.radit.hkaux (HKAux presentation display, HKPicker patch applier, HKController pad detection). Source: igawa6/dualsouls README and Assets/*.cs at main (pushed 2026-11-26, later than the 1.0.3 release of 2026-08-23, so field defaults may have moved). Save file names not checked on device.
